ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا ۝١
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اُوْحِيَ اِلَيَّ اَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَقَالُوْٓا اِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْاٰنًا عَجَبًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].
ayahs.transliteration: Qul oohiya ilayya annahustama'a nafarum minal-jinni faqaaloo innaa sami'naa qur'aanan 'ajabaa
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “It was revealed to me that a band of jinn listened in, and said, ‘We have heard a wondrous Quran.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ‌ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًا ۝٢
ayahs.textIndopak: يَّهْدِيْٓ اِلَي الرُّشْدِ فَاٰمَنَّا بِهٖؕ وَلَنْ نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا͏ٓ اَحَدًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
ayahs.transliteration: Yahdee ilar-rushdi fa'aamannaa bihee walan nushrika birabbinaa ahadaa
ayahs.translationClear: It guides to rectitude, so we have believed in it; and we will never associate anyone with our Lord.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَـٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَـٰحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَـٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَـٰحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا ۝٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاَنَّهٗ تَعٰلٰي جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَّلَا وَلَدًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'annahoo ta'aalaa jaddu rabbinaa mattakhadha saahibatan walaa waladaa
ayahs.translationClear: And exalted is the grandeur of our Lord—He never had a mate, nor a child.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًا ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاَنَّهٗ كَانَ يَقُوْلُ سَفِيْهُنَا عَلَي اللّٰهِ شَطَطًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: And that our foolish one [i.e., Iblees][1766] has been saying about Allāh an excessive transgression.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'annahoo kaana yaqoolu safeehunaa 'alallaahi shatataa

footnotes.1766: A plural form may also be understood, i.e., "the foolish ones among us."

ayahs.translationClear: But the fools among us used to say nonsense about Allah.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا ۝٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاَنَّا ظَنَنَّا͏ٓ اَنْ لَّنْ تَقُوْلَ الْاِنْسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allāh a lie.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'annaa zanannaa al lan taqoolal-insu wal-jinnu 'alallaahi kadhibaa
ayahs.translationClear: And we thought that humans and jinn would never utter lies about Allah.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاَنَّهٗ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ الْاِنْسِ يَعُوْذُوْنَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوْهُمْ رَهَقًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden [i.e., sin].
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'annahoo kaana rijaalum minal-insi ya'oodhoona birijaalim minal-jinni fazaadoohum rahaqaa
ayahs.translationClear: Some individual humans used to seek power through some individual jinn, but they only increased them in confusion.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًا ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوْا كَمَا ظَنَنْتُمْ اَنْ لَّنْ يَّبْعَثَ اللّٰهُ اَحَدًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allāh would never send anyone [as a messenger].
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'annahum zannoo kamaa zanantum al lan yab'athallaahu ahadaa
ayahs.translationClear: They thought, as you thought, that Allah would never resurrect anyone.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَـٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَـٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا ۝٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاَنَّا لَمَسْنَا السَّمَا࢜ءَ فَوَجَدْنٰهَا مُلِي͏ٔ͏َتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيْدًا وَّشُهُبًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'annaa lamasnas-samaa'a fawajadnaahaa muli'at harasan shadeedan washuhubaa
ayahs.translationClear: We probed the heaven, and found it filled with stern guards and projectiles.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَـٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْـَٔانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَـٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ‌ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْـَٔانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا ۝٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِؕ فَمَنْ يَّسْتَمِعِ الْاٰنَ يَجِدْ لَهٗ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing,[1767] but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'annaa kunnaa naq'udu minhaa maqaa'ida lissam'i faman yastami'il-aana yajid lahoo shihaabar rasadaa

footnotes.1767: Before the prophethood of Muḥammad (ﷺ) the jinn used to collect information by eavesdropping on the angels and then pass it on to fortunetellers and soothsayers.

ayahs.translationClear: We used to take up positions to listen in; but whoever listens now finds a projectile in wait for him.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاَنَّا لَا نَدْرِيْٓ اَشَرٌّ اُرِيْدَ بِمَنْ فِي الْاَرْضِ اَمْ اَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'annaa laa nadree asharrun ureeda biman fil-ardi am araada bihim rabbuhum rashadaa
ayahs.translationClear: We do not know whether ill is intended for those on earth, or if their Lord intends goodness for them.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ‌ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًا ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاَنَّا مِنَّا الصّٰلِحُوْنَ وَمِنَّا دُوْنَ ذٰلِكَؕ كُنَّا طَرَا࢜ىِٕقَ قِدَدًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.[1768]
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'annaa minnas-saalihoona waminnaa doona dhaalika kunnaa taraa'iqa qidadaa

footnotes.1768: In opinion, belief and religious practice.

ayahs.translationClear: Some of us are righteous, but some of us are less than that; we follow divergent paths.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًا ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاَنَّا ظَنَنَّا͏ٓ اَنْ لَّنْ نُّعْجِزَ اللّٰهَ فِي الْاَرْضِ وَلَنْ نُّعْجِزَهٗ هَرَبًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allāh upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'annaa zanannaa al lan nu'jizallaaha fil-ardi walan nu'jizahoo harabaa
ayahs.translationClear: We realized that we cannot defeat Allah on earth, and that we cannot escape Him by fleeing.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ‌ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا الْهُدٰٓي اٰمَنَّا بِهٖؕ فَمَنْ يُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنْۢ بِرَبِّهٖ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَّلَا رَهَقًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: And when we heard the guidance [i.e., the Qur’ān], we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.[1769]
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'annaa lammaa sami'nal-hudaa aamannaa bihee faman yu'mim birabbihee falaa yakhaafu bakhsan walaa rahaqaa

footnotes.1769: In regard to his account in the Hereafter. Nothing of his good will be diminished, nor will the evil of another be placed upon him.

ayahs.translationClear: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. Whoever believes in his Lord fears neither loss, nor burden.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ‌ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًا ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاَنَّا مِنَّا الْمُسْلِمُوْنَ وَمِنَّا الْقٰسِطُوْنَؕ فَمَنْ اَسْلَمَ فَاُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ تَحَرَّوْا رَشَدًا
ayahs.translation: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allāh], and among us are the unjust.[1770] And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'annaa minnal-muslimoona waminnal-qaasitoona faman aslama fa'ulaa'ika taharraw rashadaa

footnotes.1770: i.e., those who deviate from the truth and act tyrannically.

ayahs.translationClear: Among us are those who are submitting, and among us are the compromisers. As for those who have submitted—it is they who pursue rectitude.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَمَّا الْقٰسِطُوْنَ فَكَانُوْا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'ammal-qaasitoona fakaanoo lijahannama hatabaa
ayahs.translationClear: But as for the compromisers—they will be firewood for Hell.’”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَـٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَـٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًا ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاَنْ لَّوِ اسْتَقَامُوْا عَلَي الطَّرِيْقَةِ لَاَسْقَيْنٰهُمْ مَّا࢜ءً غَدَقًا ۙ

words.translation: surely We (would) have given them to drink

ayahs.translation: And [Allāh revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision]
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'allawistaqaamoo 'alat-tareeqati la'asqaynaahum maa'an ghadaqaa
ayahs.translationClear: Had they kept true to the Path, We would have given them plenty of water to drink.

ayahs.textUthmani: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ‌ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيْهِؕ وَمَنْ يُّعْرِضْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّهٖ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord[1771] He will put into arduous punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: Linaftinahum feehi waman yu'rid 'an dhikri rabbihee yasluk'hu 'adhaaban sa'adaa
ayahs.translationClear: To test them with it. Whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will direct him to torment ever mounting.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَـٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَـٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًا ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاَنَّ الْمَسٰجِدَ لِلّٰهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوْا مَعَ اللّٰهِ اَحَدًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: And [He revealed] that the masjids[1772] are for Allāh, so do not invoke[1773] with Allāh anyone.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'annal-masaajida lillaahi falaa tad'oo ma'allaahi ahadaa

footnotes.1772: The term "masjid" here includes every place of worship or the earth in general.

ayahs.translationClear: The places of worship are for Allah. So do not call, besides Allah, upon anyone else.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاَنَّهٗ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ اللّٰهِ يَدْعُوْهُ كَادُوْا يَكُوْنُوْنَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا ؕࣖ
ayahs.translation: And that when the Servant [i.e., Prophet] of Allāh stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."[1774]
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'annahoo lammaa qaama 'abdullaahi yad'oohu kaadoo yakoonoona 'alayhi libadaa

footnotes.1774: Crowding on top of each other in the manner of locusts in order to hear him (ﷺ). "They" may refer to the jinn or to the disbelievers among the Arabs.

ayahs.translationClear: And when the servant of Allah got up calling on Him, they almost fell on him in a mass.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا ۝٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اِنَّمَا͏ٓ اَدْعُوْا رَبِّيْ وَلَا͏ٓ اُشْرِكُ بِهٖٓ اَحَدًا
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul innamaa ad'oo rabbee walaa ushriku bihee ahadaa
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “I pray only to my Lord, and I never associate anyone with Him.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا ۝٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اِنِّيْ لَا͏ٓ اَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَّلَا رَشَدًا
ayahs.translation: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul innee laa amliku lakum darran walaa rashadaa
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “It is not in my power to harm you, nor to bring you to right conduct.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا ۝٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اِنِّيْ لَنْ يُّجِيْرَنِيْ مِنَ اللّٰهِ اَحَدٌ࣢ۙ وَّلَنْ اَجِدَ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖ مُلْتَحَدًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allāh anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
ayahs.transliteration: Qul innee lan yujeeranee minallaahi ahadun walan ajida min doonihee multahadaa
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “No one can protect me from Allah, and I will not find any refuge except with Him.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَّا بَلَـٰغًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَـٰلَـٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّا بَلَـٰغًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَـٰلَـٰتِهِۦ‌ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۝٢٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلَّا بَلٰغًا مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَرِسٰلٰتِهٖؕ وَمَنْ يَّعْصِ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوْلَهٗ فَاِنَّ لَهٗ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا͏ٓ اَبَدًا ؕ
ayahs.translation: But [I have for you] only notification from Allāh, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
ayahs.transliteration: Illaa balaagham minallaahi warisaalaatihee waman ya'sillaaha warasoolahoo fa'inna lahoo naara jahannama khaalideena feehaa abadaa
ayahs.translationClear: Except for a proclamation from Allah and His messages. He who defies Allah and His Messenger—for him is the Fire of Hell, in which they will dwell forever.”

ayahs.textUthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: حَتّٰٓي اِذَا رَاَوْا مَا يُوْعَدُوْنَ فَسَيَعْلَمُوْنَ مَنْ اَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَّاَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
ayahs.translation: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
ayahs.transliteration: Hattaa idhaa ra'aw maa yoo'adoona fasaya'lamoona man ad'afu naasiran wa'aqallu 'adadaa
ayahs.translationClear: Until, when they see what they were promised, they will know who is weaker in helpers, and fewer in numbers.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا ۝٢٥
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اِنْ اَدْرِيْٓ اَقَرِيْبٌ مَّا تُوْعَدُوْنَ اَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهٗ رَبِّيْٓ اَمَدًا
ayahs.translation: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul in adree aqareebum maa too'adoona am yaj'alu lahoo rabbee amadaa
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “I do not know whether what you are promised is near, or whether my Lord will extend it for a period.”

ayahs.textUthmani: عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا ۝٢٦
ayahs.textIndopak: عٰلِمُ الْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلٰي غَيْبِهٖٓ اَحَدًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
ayahs.transliteration: 'aalimul-ghaybi falaa yuz'hiru 'alaa ghaybihee ahadaa
ayahs.translationClear: The Knower of the Invisible; He does not disclose His Invisible to anyone.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًا ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلَّا مَنِ ارْتَضٰي مِنْ رَّسُوْلٍ فَاِنَّهٗ يَسْلُكُ مِنْۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهٖ رَصَدًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before him [i.e., each messenger] and behind him observers[1775]
ayahs.transliteration: Illaa manirtadaa mir rasoolin fa'innahoo yasluku mim bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihee rasadaa

footnotes.1775: Guardian angels to protect the messenger and the message.

ayahs.translationClear: Except to a messenger of His choosing. He then dispatches guards before him and behind him.

ayahs.textUthmani: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: لِّيَعْلَمَ اَنْ قَدْ اَبْلَغُوْا رِسٰلٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَاَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَاَحْصٰي كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَدًا ࣖ
ayahs.translation: That he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] may know[1776] that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
ayahs.transliteration: Liya'lama an qad ablaghoo risaalaati rabbihim wa'ahaata bimaa ladayhim wa'ahsaa kulla shay'in 'adadaa

footnotes.1776: This phrase may also be read: "So He [i.e., Allāh] may make evident."

ayahs.translationClear: That He may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord. He encompasses what they have, and has tallied everything by number.
